sources: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 232281 (public search API)

values.note: Single site $29 a night, double $58 (FS page, status table, and recreation.gov 2026 and 2027). One vehicle included; $8 per extra vehicle per night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/olive-ridge-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night Double Site: $58 per night', updated September 14, 2026) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('Olive Ridge | 56 | 40' | Reserve now | $29/58') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232281/rates (Peak Season 2026 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29, double 58) + notice 'Any additional vehicles will be charged $8.00 per vehicle per night', read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/olive-ridge-campground ('There is no electricity, hook-ups, dump stations, or showers') + recreation.gov notice ('There are not utility or water hook-ups, dump stations, or showers within the campground'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Firewood sold in the campground; bear lockers at tent-pad sites.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/olive-ridge-campground ('vault toilets, and trash services are provided. There is no electricity, hook-ups, dump stations, or showers. All campsites with a tent pad have a bear locker') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232281 ('Firewood is for sale in the campground'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 56 sites; recreation.gov calls 26 suitable for RVs and 30 better for tents. Parking spurs vary a lot: in the catalog 12 of 53 are under 23 ft (18-22), the longest 45-50 ft are first-come sites (19-22, 25); the reservable sites run to 40 ft. All back-in (one parallel).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/olive-ridge-campground ('There are 56 sites that will accommodate tents, campers, trailers, and RVs') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('Olive Ridge | 56 | 40'') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232281 ('There are 56 sites in the campground. Twenty six are suitable for RV camping and 30 are more suitable for tents') + per-site catalog (53 sites, Max Vehicle Length 18-50, 52 Back-In, 1 Parallel), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Boulder Ranger District Campground Status: 'Olive Ridge | 56 | 40' | Reserve now | $29/58 | May 15 - Sept 13'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Sites 26-40, 42 and 44-56 book on recreation.gov for the 2026 season May 15 - Sept 12 (2027: May 14 - Sept 11), closing 4 days before arrival; sites 1-24, 38, 41, 42 and 46 are first-come (the FS list numbers 38 and 42 both ways). 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimums; 14 nights in a rolling 60 days. A reserved site not occupied within 26 hours goes first-come.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232281 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days', reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival'; notice 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-12, 2027-05-14 to 2027-09-11) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/olive-ridge-campground ('Campsites 1 - 24, 38, 41, 42, and 46 are first come, first served. Campsites 26 - 40, 42, and 44 - 56 are reservable'), read 2026-10-26

note: Boulder RD, Arapaho-Roosevelt NF: 8,350 ft in ponderosa pine and aspen on the west side of CO-7 at mile marker 14, between Allenspark and Meeker Park, near the Wild Basin area of Rocky Mountain NP (main park entrance 14 mi north in Estes Park). Gravel/dirt interior roads. --Claude
summary: Fees $29 confirmed (FS, status table, rec.gov 2026/2027). Sites count 53 -> 56 (FS and rec.gov), max_rig_ft 60 -> 40 (forest status table Max Spur 40'; nothing supports 60), pull_through false. Hookups none confirmed (electric 0, water/sewer false). Added vault toilets, no showers/dump, season May 15 - Sept 13 (status table), booking on rec.gov with 4-day cutoff, some FCFS sites, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 14-night max, booking season 05-15 to 09-12. Pin 134 m from the catalog centroid. Note: dropped the site count, length and 'reservable' repeats.
flags: Length conflict (all above 23 ft): status table Max Spur 40'; catalog spurs 18-50 ft (first-come sites 020 and 022 are 50 ft, 019/021/025 45 ft); the stored 60 had no source. Set 40. Note 12 of 53 catalogued spurs are under 23 ft, so EKKO needs a site picked by length.

Phone missing: Boulder Ranger District office 970-295-6600 (fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/offices, 2140 Yarmouth Ave, Boulder); recreation.gov gives 303-541-2500 as the facility phone and (530) 529-0578 for facility information (concessionaire).
Website is the recreation.gov listing; agency page if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/olive-ridge-campground
